options.detail: Scenic off-road tour through Kipu Ranch’s pastures, tropical Huleia Valley, and rainforest canopy to Mt. Haupu backdrop.

services.name: Waterfall Trail Expedition
services.desc: Waterfall Triple Trail Expedition Tour Highlights Extended Riding Times (in comparison to other tour options) - Trek across all 3 trail systems along Kipu Ranch. Movie Locations – This tour highlights many movie locations for amazing photo and video taking opportunity. Waterfall Lookout – Drive right up to our private waterfall. Walk to waterfall is a moderate hike on uneven ground, approximately 75 meters down and back up. Short hike is optional for those that would like to view waterfall from top. Waterfall Triple Trail Expedition Kipu Ranch Adventures Waterfall Triple Trail Expedition Off-Road Touring at its Finest! • Combo of All 3 Trail Systems • Ages 9+

services.name: Ultimate Ranch Tour
services.desc: Tour Highlights Diverse Landscape – More challenging trails, 360° view of Kauai, and movie backdrops Huleia Jungle - Traverse through wild coffee, abundant bamboo forests, and tropical ginger plants Signature Tour – Classic Stop-N-Go Tour, less downtime, cover more ground to get to scenic stop locations Share trails with cattle, wild pigs, pheasants, peacocks and wild chickens Learn about Kipu Ranch's history from royalty, to sugar plantation, to what it is today Great for beginners or experienced riders Ultimate Ranch Tour - "Original Signature Tour" Join us for a 4x4 Off-Road Touring • Includes Hollywood Movie Locations • Ages 9+

blurb: Guests explore the beautiful scenery of Kipu Ranch in Kauai behind the wheel of top-of-the-line Kawasaki Teryx4 and MulePro FXT off-road machines. Tours include guided excursions through historic Kipu Ranch, a 3,000-acre privately-owned cattle ranch with rich history and Hawaiian legends. The company offers private groups, families, companies, and incentive groups tours.
extraNote: Water activities are subject to change at any time due to weather conditions. · However, it is customary and much appreciated to tip your tour guides. · Preparing for Your Adventure Guests may get dusty or muddy depending on weather conditions. · Please review our cancellation policy regarding the late arrival rescheduling fee. · Tours operate rain or shine with the exception of severe weather conditions. · You may cancel your waitlist request at any time at no cost. · Rescheduled activities are non-refundable. · No call / No shows are non-refundable. · A full refund will be provided if the tour is canceled due to weather, mechanical failure, or unsafe conditions. · Private Tour Terms & Cond
